name: VDRL SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-VDRL-16 VDRL Shaker is a specialized orbital rotator used extensively in clinical diagnostic laboratories, hematology departments, and blood banks. It is primarily utilized for mixing and auto-agglutination tests on slides, including VDRL and syphilis screening. This compact unit delivers smooth, continuous circular motions ensuring highly reproducible diagnostic reactions.
features: 13 x 13 inches platform equipped with specialized spring holders
Rotational speed strictly adjustable from 150 to 200 RPM
Integrated Digital LED RPM display for accurate speed tracking
In-built Digital Timer programmable up to 60 minutes
Durable powder-coated MS sheet housing for long laboratory life

specifications.Target Applications: Auto-agglutination tests, VDRL tests, Syphilis testing in Pathology/Blood Banks
